ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), NOT($Permission.Admin_No_Validation), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)), ISBLANK(Country__c), AND( ISBLANK(NumberOfEmployees), NOT($Permission.Contract_Manager_No_Validation) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
You cannot change the Owner unless the required fields are filled:
Lead Source (all profiles)
Country (except System Administrators)
No. of Employees (except Contract Managers) Please fill the missing fields before reassigning the Owner."
